details.pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM olist_orders_dataset LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM olist_orders_dataset WHERE order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers FROM olist_customers_dataset LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS seller_count FROM olist_sellers_dataset LIMIT 1000
SELECT AVG(review_score) AS average_review_score FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset LIMIT 100
SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS usage_count FROM olist_order_payments_dataset GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY usage_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM olist_orders_dataset GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status LIMIT 100
SELECT MAX(price) AS highest_item_price FROM olist_order_items_dataset LIMIT 1000
SELECT AVG(oi.price) AS avg_item_price, AVG(oi.freight_value) AS avg_freight_value FROM olist_order_items_dataset AS oi LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS reviews_score_1 FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset WHERE review_score = 1 LIMIT 100
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS delivered_percentage FROM olist_orders_dataset LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS canceled_orders FROM olist_orders_dataset WHERE order_status = 'canceled' AND STRFTIME('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' LIMIT 100
SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset GROUP BY review_score ORDER BY review_score LIMIT 100
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM olist_order_items_dataset AS oi JOIN olist_orders_dataset AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS average_order_value FROM olist_order_items_dataset AS oi JOIN olist_orders_dataset AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 1000

SELECT pct.product_category_name_english AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue FROM olist_orders_dataset AS o JOIN olist_order_items_dataset AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN olist_products_dataset AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation AS pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY pct.product_category_name_english ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT c.customer_state AS state, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM olist_orders_dataset AS o JOIN olist_customers_dataset AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM olist_orders_dataset AS o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 100

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS delivered_order_revenue FROM olist_orders_dataset AS o JOIN olist_order_items_dataset AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 100

SELECT pc.product_category_name_english AS category, COUNT(*) AS items_sold FROM olist_order_items_dataset AS oi JOIN olist_orders_dataset AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN olist_products_dataset AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation AS pc ON pc.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY pc.product_category_name_english ORDER BY items_sold DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(oi.freight_value), 2) AS avg_freight FROM olist_orders_dataset AS o JOIN olist_customers_dataset AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN olist_order_items_dataset AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_freight DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT oi.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue FROM olist_order_items_dataset AS oi JOIN olist_orders_dataset AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT AVG(JULIANDAY(order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_delivery_time_days FROM olist_orders_dataset WHERE order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 1000
SELECT AVG(payment_installments) AS avg_installments FROM olist_order_payments_dataset WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card' LIMIT 100
SELECT payment_type, ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS total_payment_value FROM olist_order_payments_dataset GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY total_payment_value DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT s.seller_state, COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM olist_sellers_dataset AS s GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue FROM olist_orders_dataset AS o JOIN olist_order_items_dataset AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_delivered_orders FROM olist_orders_dataset AS o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND JULIANDAY(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(o.order_estimated_delivery_date) > 0 LIMIT 100

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN JULIANDAY(order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(order_estimated_delivery_date) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_delivery_rate_percent FROM olist_orders_dataset WHERE order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 1000

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS purchase_month, COUNT(*) AS late_deliveries FROM olist_orders_dataset AS o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND JULIANDAY(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(o.order_estimated_delivery_date) > 0 GROUP BY purchase_month ORDER BY late_deliveries DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_multiple_orders FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM olist_orders_dataset AS o JOIN olist_customers_dataset AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS sub LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue FROM olist_orders_dataset AS o JOIN olist_order_items_dataset AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN olist_customers_dataset AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3
